newsitem.title: USA: Viking Resources reduces debt by 43 pct.
newsitem.headline: Viking Resources reduces debt by 43 pct.

text.p: Viking Resources International Inc said on Tuesday that it cut debts to $425,599 from $757,222, or by 43 percent, through the efforts of LBI Group Inc.
The company said in a release that certain debts totaling $331,623 were settled for $31,001 and the issuance of 180,000 shares of common stock.

Viking said LBI Group, a Florida-based consulting firm, was helping the company organize a new management team, reduce debt and bring it into compliance with U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filings requirements.
